<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1771422_refund_0.Refund details</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>Refund details</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var Refund_details = Class.create();
Refund_details.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
	populateRefundDetails: function() {
    var producerValues = this.getParameter('sysparm_orderId');
    gs.info('Hello : ' + producerValues);
 
    var refund = {
      full_name: null,
      email: null,
      contact_no: null,
      door_no_street_line_1: null,
      street_line_2: null,
      street_line_3: null,
      city: null,
      state: null,
      pincode: null
    };
 
    var order = new GlideRecord('x_1771422_refund_0_order_details');
    order.addQuery('order_id', producerValues);
    order.query();
 
    if (order.next()) {
      refund.full_name = order.full_name;
      refund.email = order.email;
      refund.contact_no = order.contact_no;
      refund.door_no_street_line_1 = order.door_no_street_line_1;
      refund.street_line_2 = order.street_line_2;
      refund.street_line_3 = order.street_line_3;
      refund.city = order.city;
      refund.state = order.state;
      refund.pincode = order.pincode;
    } else {
      gs.info("No matching order found for Order ID: " + producerValues);
    }
 
    var payload = JSON.stringify(refund);
    gs.info("Response Payload: " + payload);
    return payload;
  },

    type: 'Refund details'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-07 16:27:57</sys_created_on><sys_id>f6653e1e83aa6e105d2db4b6feaad325</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Refund details</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Refundify" source="x_1771422_refund_0">f7ec429d83262a105d2db4b6feaad363</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Refundify">f7ec429d83262a105d2db4b6feaad363</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_f6653e1e83aa6e105d2db4b6feaad325</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-07 16:27:57</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
